messages:
Alex C: Quick heads-up — I slid model-service v2.1 into the train slot at 09:00 PST. ETA ~10m deploy, canary will be 5% for 15m. Who's taking smoke?
Maria G: @Alex C I can own smoke for model-service. Will run the standard checklist and report back. :thumbsup:
Alex C: awesome, thanks. Devon will you still be doing the DB migration later in the 09:30 slot? trying to avoid overlap.
Devon: yep still on DB migration at 09:30. I can shift if there's a hard conflict but prefer not to. Migration includes a short schema write-back + backfill (should be <7m).
Sasha: quick note — if the migration overlaps with canary traffic we should route the canary to a different shard. Ops Oncall can you confirm routing policy?
Ops Oncall: @Sasha routing policy: prefer region affinity then fall back to spare pool. For this window I can open a temporary shard and add a routing rule. Ping me 5m before deploy to flip traffic.
Jamie L: I'm on rollback readiness for the train. I have the rollback playbook staged and a script: `./tools/rollback --service model-service --tag rollback-2027-09`. Will coordinate with Release Bot for automated rollback threshold.
Release Bot: Canary metrics watch created: model-service/canary/1834567890. Triggers: error_rate>1.2% OR p95 latency +50% over baseline for 3m => automatic rollback (notify channel).
Maria G: Smoke checklist (mini):
```
- sanity /health endpoints (200)
- sample-gen integrity (tokenization match)
- embedding service basic sample (cos sim > .85)
- logs show no OOM / kernel errors
- dependent svc heartbeats OK
```
Maria G: I'll paste results after the canary step. If anything fails, I recommend immediate rollback and a quick postmortem.
Alex C: Plan B if canary fails: rollback + re-queue to next train slot (12:00). Devon, does that slot work for you if we need to requeue?
Devon: 12:00 works for me.
Sasha: Also can we add a brief note to the deploy ticket about the shard routing? small ops change but important.
Alex C: done — added shard routing note to the ticket and linked the rollback script.
Jamie L: I'll monitor the automated rollback channel and be ready to confirm manual rollback if needed.
Maria G: starting smoke now (pre-canary quick checks). Will update in ~6m.
Maria G: pre-canary checks: health OK, sample-gen OK, embeddings basic OK, logs clean. Proceeding to canary.
Release Bot: Canary started at 1834567920. Allocated 5% traffic.
Ops Oncall: routing rule applied, canary traffic isolated on shard-9.
Maria G: canary running — observing metrics.
Maria G: after 7m: p95 up 10% but within threshold, error_rate stable. continuing run.
Release Bot: Canary monitor: p95 +12% (baseline 220ms -> 246ms), error_rate 0.4%. No rollback trigger.
Maria G: smoke PASS. No anomalies in logs. :tada:
Alex C: fantastic. Proceed with full rollout at 09:20 then?
Jamie L: I'll approve the rollout once Release Bot posts final canary summary.
Release Bot: Canary complete at 1834568030. No triggers. Ready for rollout.
Alex C: rolling to 100% in 2m. tagging release: `model-service@v2.1-deploy-1834567890`.
Devon: heads-up I'll monitor DB connection pool during the full rollout.
Sasha: I scheduled a short post-deploy check-in at 09:40 PST in case we need to triage.
Maria G: all good on my end. great job folks :)
Alex C: thanks team — closing slot. If any issues pop up ping #eng-oncall and tag me.
